CBO projects a deeper 26% cut to Social Security benefits by 2032.
Around 70 million retirees receive Social Security checks each month, but with recent staff cuts, many are worried about delays.
When multiplied by the estimated COLA of 3.5% or 0.035%, you can expect a monthly benefit of about $2,143.48 — about a $72 increase.
Some Medicare costs for 2027 aren’t final yet, but the latest government forecasts offer a clearer picture of what beneficiaries can expect.

The announcement will give workers and seniors a clearer idea of how Social Security benefits and taxes will change next year.Here are four major changes expected in the announcement.2027 Social Security COLA Will Be AnnouncedThe COLA will likely be the most closely watched part of the October announcement because it determines how much Social Security checks will increase beginning with the January 2027 payment.The Senior Citizens League currently estimates that the 2027 COLA will be around 3.5%.

Social Security October update: Social Security’s annual October update is almost here, and the cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) is not the only number worth watching.The Social Security Administration is set to release its list of 2027 program updates on October 14, 2026.
Workers generally need 40 Social Security credits to qualify for retirement benefits.
The Social Security Administration will announce the 2026 cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) on October 15, provided the government shutdown has ended.
In the meantime, two of three data points needed to determine the COLA are available, which means we already have a good sense for how much benefits will increase next year.
There are two noteworthy trends in the chart above.
First, the average retired-worker benefit tends to increase between ages 62 and 70.
That is primarily due to differences in claim age.
Workers are entitled to Social Security at age 62 , but they maximize their benefit by delaying until age 70.
© 1995 - 2026 The Motley Fool . All rights reserved.
The chart below shows the average monthly benefit for retired workers aged 62 to 80 as of June 2025.
For example, the CPI-W increased 2.5% in the third quarter of 2024, so Social Security benefits received a 2.5% COLA in 2025 .
That happens because Social Security payments are based on lifetime income and wages tend to increase over time.
You can also view your COLA notice through the my Social Security portal.
Read on to learn how much additional income retired workers can expect from Social Security.
October brings changes to two of the most important benefit programs for millions of Latino families.
As of October 1, new SNAP changes have taken effect: maximum food assistance benefits have seen a slight increase because of inflation.
Meanwhile, Social Security is just days away from receiving the inflation data that will determine how much benefits will increase in 2027.

Important note : the Medicare Part B premium is deducted from many Social Security payments, so the actual net increase will also depend on the 2027 premium.
The minimum SNAP benefits increase for households of one or two people increases from $24 to $25 .
If September continues that trend, the increase would be higher than this year’s 2.8% COLA and the 2.7% estimate in the Social Security trustees’ intermediate projection.
The official figure, however, will not be known until Social Security publishes it.
The Department of Agriculture (USDA) adjusts SNAP amounts annually based on food costs.
The new amounts are in effect from October 1, 2026, through September 30, 2027 .
